description: IntentSQL Alpha v2 internal corpus (core, paraphrase, adversarial, rejection families) on the bundled databases.

cases.question: How many episodes belong to season 2?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM episodes WHERE season = 2

cases.question: List every episode title containing Hacker, alphabetically.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT title FROM episodes WHERE title LIKE '%Hacker%' ORDER BY title ASC

cases.question: How many episodes originally aired during 2019?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM episodes WHERE air_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'

cases.question: Give me the three most recent episode airings. Return title and air date, newest first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT title, air_date FROM episodes ORDER BY air_date DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: How many different episode topics are recorded?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT topic) FROM episodes

cases.question: How many Public School records are in Boston?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE city='Boston' AND type='Public School'

cases.question: How many Charter School records are in Boston?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE city='Boston' AND type='Charter School'

cases.question: Show districts with per-pupil expenditure between 30000 and 36000 inclusive. Return district name and expenditure, highest expenditure first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT districts.name, expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures JOIN districts ON expenditures.district_id=districts.id WHERE expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure BETWEEN 30000 AND 36000 ORDER BY expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure DESC

cases.question: Show the five districts with the highest per-pupil expenditure. Return district name and per-pupil expenditure, highest first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT districts.name, expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures JOIN districts ON expenditures.district_id=districts.id ORDER BY expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: List each school type and its number of schools, largest count first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, type ASC

cases.question: For charter schools, show the five cities with the most schools. Return city and count, highest count first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE type='Charter School' GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, city ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many players have no birth country recorded?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE birth_country IS NULL

cases.question: How many players have USA as their recorded birth-country code?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE birth_country='USA'

cases.question: Which birth-country codes have at least 100 players? Return country code and player count, largest count first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT birth_country, COUNT(*) FROM players GROUP BY birth_country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, birth_country ASC

cases.question: What is the maximum home-run total recorded in a performance?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(HR) FROM performances

cases.question: From 1990 through 2005, show the years whose maximum home-run total was at least 60. Return year and maximum home runs, highest maximum first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year, MAX(HR) FROM performances WHERE year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2005 GROUP BY year HAVING MAX(HR) >= 60 ORDER BY MAX(HR) DESC, year ASC

cases.question: Show the five highest salary records for players whose birth-country code is USA. Return first name, last name, year, and salary, highest salary first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT players.first_name, players.last_name, salaries.year, salaries.salary FROM salaries JOIN players ON salaries.player_id=players.id WHERE players.birth_country='USA' ORDER BY salaries.salary DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Show the five tallest players whose recorded birth-country code is CAN. Return first name, last name, and height. Sort by height descending, then last name alphabetically.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT first_name,last_name,height FROM players WHERE birth_country='CAN' ORDER BY height DESC,last_name ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many different recorded batting-side codes are there?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bats) FROM players

cases.question: Return year and salary for salary records between 12000000 and 15000000 inclusive, highest salary first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year,salary FROM salaries WHERE salary BETWEEN 12000000 AND 15000000 ORDER BY salary DESC

cases.question: How many Boston schools aren't public schools?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE city='Boston' AND type!='Public School'

cases.question: Count schools in Boston, excluding the public ones.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE city='Boston' AND type!='Public School'

cases.question: In Boston, how many schools have a type other than Public School?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE city='Boston' AND type!='Public School'

cases.question: Give me the number of Boston schools that are not of the Public School type.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE city='Boston' AND type!='Public School'

cases.question: How many players were born in Canada?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE birth_country='CAN'

cases.question: Count Canada-born players.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE birth_country='CAN'

cases.question: How many players have Canada as their birth country?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE birth_country='CAN'

cases.question: Give me the number of players born in Canada.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE birth_country='CAN'

cases.question: Which district has the lowest per-pupil expenditure? Return district name and per-pupil expenditure.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT districts.name, expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures JOIN districts ON expenditures.district_id=districts.id ORDER BY expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What district spends the least per pupil? Give me its name and the amount.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT districts.name, expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures JOIN districts ON expenditures.district_id=districts.id ORDER BY expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Name the district with the smallest per-pupil expenditure and show that expenditure.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT districts.name, expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures JOIN districts ON expenditures.district_id=districts.id ORDER BY expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Find the single district with the minimum per-pupil expenditure. Return its name and expenditure.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT districts.name, expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures JOIN districts ON expenditures.district_id=districts.id ORDER BY expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which school type is the most common? Give me the type and count.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT type,COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,type ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What kind of school appears most often? Return the school type and how many there are.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT type,COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,type ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which value of school type occurs most frequently? Show the value and count.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT type,COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,type ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Give me the most common school type together with its number of schools.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT type,COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,type ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Show the five highest salary records for players born in the USA. Return first name, last name, year, and salary, highest salary first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT players.first_name,players.last_name,salaries.year,salaries.salary FROM salaries JOIN players ON salaries.player_id=players.id WHERE players.birth_country='USA' ORDER BY salaries.salary DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Give me the top five salaries belonging to USA-born players, with player name, year, and salary.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT players.first_name,players.last_name,salaries.year,salaries.salary FROM salaries JOIN players ON salaries.player_id=players.id WHERE players.birth_country='USA' ORDER BY salaries.salary DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Which five salary records are largest among players born in the USA? Show first name, last name, year, and salary.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT players.first_name,players.last_name,salaries.year,salaries.salary FROM salaries JOIN players ON salaries.player_id=players.id WHERE players.birth_country='USA' ORDER BY salaries.salary DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: For players born in the USA, return only the five biggest salary records, largest first, with name, year, and salary.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT players.first_name,players.last_name,salaries.year,salaries.salary FROM salaries JOIN players ON salaries.player_id=players.id WHERE players.birth_country='USA' ORDER BY salaries.salary DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Show the season and title of episodes whose topic is exactly Fractions.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT season,title FROM episodes WHERE topic='Fractions'

cases.question: Show season and title for episodes with the word Fractions anywhere in the topic text. Sort by season, then title alphabetically.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT season,title FROM episodes WHERE topic LIKE '%Fractions%' ORDER BY season ASC,title ASC

cases.question: Show districts spending from 30k through 36k per pupil. Return district and per-pupil expenditure, highest first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT districts.name,expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures JOIN districts ON expenditures.district_id=districts.id WHERE expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure BETWEEN 30000 AND 36000 ORDER BY expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure DESC

cases.question: How many episodes aired during February 2020?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM episodes WHERE air_date BETWEEN '2020-02-01' AND '2020-02-29'

cases.question: Who are the five biggest per-student spenders? Give me the district and what they spend per pupil.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT districts.name,expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures JOIN districts ON expenditures.district_id=districts.id ORDER BY expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: List every school type with its number of schools, from most common to least common.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT type,COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,type ASC

cases.question: Between 1990 and 2005, which year had the highest maximum home-run total? Return the year and maximum.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year,MAX(HR) FROM performances WHERE year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2005 GROUP BY year ORDER BY MAX(HR) DESC,year ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: From 1990 through 2005, list every year by its maximum home-run total, greatest to smallest.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year,MAX(HR) FROM performances WHERE year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2005 GROUP BY year ORDER BY MAX(HR) DESC,year ASC

cases.question: How many players have a recorded birth-country code other than USA?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE birth_country != 'USA'

cases.question: Give me five left-handed batters born after 1970, with the youngest players first and last name alphabetically for ties. Return first name, last name, and birth year.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT first_name,last_name,birth_year FROM players WHERE bats='L' AND birth_year>1970 ORDER BY birth_year DESC,last_name ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Worcester schools, but leave out the charter ones. How many are left?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE city='Worcester' AND type!='Charter School'

cases.question: For Boston and Cambridge, break down the number of schools by city and school type.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT city,type,COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE city IN ('Boston','Cambridge') GROUP BY city,type ORDER BY city ASC,type ASC

cases.question: Which episode titles finish with the word Day? Put them in alphabetical order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT title FROM episodes WHERE title LIKE '%Day' ORDER BY title ASC

cases.question: Find me five schools with Academy anywhere in their name. Include city and school type. Alphabetical by school name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT name,city,type FROM schools WHERE name LIKE '%Academy%' ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Give me the three latest airings. I only need the title and air date, newest first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT title,air_date FROM episodes ORDER BY air_date DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Give me salaries no lower than 12 million and no higher than 15 million. Return year and salary, ordered from largest to smallest.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year,salary FROM salaries WHERE salary BETWEEN 12000000 AND 15000000 ORDER BY salary DESC

cases.question: Which district spends more than 40k per pupil? Give me its name and per-pupil expenditure.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT districts.name,expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM expenditures JOIN districts ON expenditures.district_id=districts.id WHERE expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure > 40000

cases.question: Which birth countries produced at least 100 players? Show the biggest contributors first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT birth_country,COUNT(*) FROM players GROUP BY birth_country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,birth_country ASC

cases.question: List the names of Boston schools whose type is either Public School or Charter School, alphabetically.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM schools WHERE city='Boston' AND type IN ('Public School','Charter School') ORDER BY name ASC

cases.question: What was the average salary in 2001, rounded to two decimal places?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary),2) FROM salaries WHERE year=2001

cases.question: For every birth country, give me its two tallest players.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT birth_country,first_name,last_name,height FROM (SELECT birth_country,first_name,last_name,height,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY birth_country ORDER BY height DESC,last_name ASC,first_name ASC) rn FROM players WHERE birth_country IS NOT NULL) WHERE rn<=2

cases.question: What is the average of the yearly maximum home-run totals from 1990 through 2005?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(year_max) FROM (SELECT year,MAX(HR) AS year_max FROM performances WHERE year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2005 GROUP BY year)

cases.question: Show every school name together with the per-pupil expenditure of its district.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT schools.name,expenditures.per_pupil_expenditure FROM schools JOIN districts ON schools.district_id=districts.id JOIN expenditures ON districts.id=expenditures.district_id

cases.question: Show each school name with the exemplary-teacher percentage for its district.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT schools.name,staff_evaluations.exemplary FROM schools JOIN districts ON schools.district_id=districts.id JOIN staff_evaluations ON districts.id=staff_evaluations.district_id

cases.question: Which five teams produced the most total hits in 2001? Show team and total hits.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT teams.name,SUM(performances.H) FROM performances JOIN teams ON performances.team_id=teams.id WHERE performances.year=2001 GROUP BY teams.id ORDER BY SUM(performances.H) DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Which five teams had the lowest average salary in 2001? Show team and average salary.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT teams.name,AVG(salaries.salary) FROM salaries JOIN teams ON salaries.team_id=teams.id WHERE salaries.year=2001 GROUP BY teams.id ORDER BY AVG(salaries.salary) ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Show salary records from 2001 for players born in the USA. Return player name and salary.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT players.first_name,players.last_name,salaries.salary FROM salaries JOIN players ON salaries.player_id=players.id WHERE salaries.year=2001 AND players.birth_country='USA'

cases.question: Show the five highest USA-born player salaries, sorting equal salaries by last name alphabetically.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT players.first_name,players.last_name,salaries.salary FROM salaries JOIN players ON salaries.player_id=players.id WHERE players.birth_country='USA' ORDER BY salaries.salary DESC,players.last_name ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Who were the ten cheapest players per hit in 2001? Show first name, last name, and dollars per hit.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT players.first_name,players.last_name,salaries.salary*1.0/performances.H FROM players JOIN salaries ON players.id=salaries.player_id JOIN performances ON players.id=performances.player_id AND salaries.year=performances.year WHERE salaries.year=2001 AND performances.H>0 ORDER BY salaries.salary*1.0/performances.H ASC LIMIT 10

cases.question: Label each salary record as high when salary is at least 10000000 and standard otherwise. Return year, salary, and label.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year,salary,CASE WHEN salary>=10000000 THEN 'high' ELSE 'standard' END FROM salaries LIMIT 100

cases.question: How many distinct combinations of birth country and birth year are recorded?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT birth_country,birth_year FROM players WHERE birth_country IS NOT NULL AND birth_year IS NOT NULL)

cases.question: Show players who are not in the set consisting of USA-born players or Canadian-born left-handed batters.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT first_name,last_name FROM players WHERE NOT (birth_country='USA' OR (birth_country='CAN' AND bats='L'))

cases.question: Show players who are either USA-born right-handed batters or Canada-born left-handed batters.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT first_name,last_name FROM players WHERE (birth_country='USA' AND bats='R') OR (birth_country='CAN' AND bats='L') LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show salary records that are above that player's own career average salary.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT s1.player_id,s1.year,s1.salary FROM salaries s1 WHERE s1.salary > (SELECT AVG(s2.salary) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.player_id=s1.player_id) LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show players who never have a salary record.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT first_name,last_name FROM players p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM salaries s WHERE s.player_id=p.id) LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show pairs of different players who were born in the same city.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p1.first_name,p1.last_name,p2.first_name,p2.last_name,p1.birth_city FROM players p1 JOIN players p2 ON p1.birth_city=p2.birth_city AND p1.id<p2.id WHERE p1.birth_city IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show player name, salary year, salary, and team name for salary records.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT players.first_name,players.last_name,salaries.year,salaries.salary,teams.name FROM salaries JOIN players ON salaries.player_id=players.id JOIN teams ON salaries.team_id=teams.id LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show salary records whose salary is above the overall average salary.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year,salary FROM salaries WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM salaries)

cases.question: For each year, show the percentage of performances with at least 20 home runs.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN HR>=20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) FROM performances GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

cases.question: Which years had a maximum home-run total above the average of all yearly maximums?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT year,MAX(HR) FROM performances GROUP BY year HAVING MAX(HR) > (SELECT AVG(year_max) FROM (SELECT MAX(HR) AS year_max FROM performances GROUP BY year))
